category: hosted macOS Pod for coding agents

free_tier.stated: 3 Pod-hours free, once, with 1 Pod at a time and no extra hours after the allowance runs out
free_tier.notes: A Pod-hour is one Pod running for one hour, metered per second. The ten minutes after the final session ends count toward it.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the Pod is a macOS virtual machine with Xcode and Simulators, not an object store

retention.stated: Agent logs and screenshots are kept for 30 days, then deleted; Team and Enterprise can set a shorter period. Pod-local data is destroyed with the Pod.
retention.notes: The Pod is destroyed ten minutes after the final session ends; uncommitted work goes to a rescue branch.

egress.terms: Pods make outbound connections only to api.anthropic.com, api.openai.com, the git host and package registries; there are no inbound ports. No per-GB egress price or allowance is published.

interface_detail: Sessions start from Claude Code, Codex, claude.ai, Claude Desktop or Slack; there is no SSH, VNC or screen sharing, and agents are followed through the conversation, git branches and dashboard logs and screenshots.
tooling: a Claude Team or Enterprise self-hosted environment key, or an OpenAI Agents API webhook, plus a git host for the repository.
chaining: Pods build and test iOS apps for coding agents, pushing commits and screenshots to the git host; a developer needing a persistent disk or SSH uses a rented dedicated Mac instead.

limits.value: 3 Pod-hours once on Free; 1 Pod at a time; sessions stop when the hours run out
2 concurrent xcodebuild runs and 3 to 4 Simulators per Pod; sessions queue when all Pods are busy

limits_note: Pro is USD 99 a month for 300 Pod-hours with up to 4 Pods and USD 0.40 per extra Pod-hour; Team is USD 399 for 1,500 hours with up to 10 Pods and USD 0.30 per extra Pod-hour.
binding_note: The one-time 3 Pod-hours on Free are used first, and the build slots queue before they fail, so the Pod-hour allowance is the constraint that ends a session.

identity_cost.detail: The sign-in page creates an account with a work email address or through Google or GitHub and sends a sign-in link; the pricing page states no card is needed for Free.

reliability_note: No uptime commitment on Free, Pro or Team; Pods are destroyed ten minutes after the final session ends and local data is not kept.
confidence_note: Prices, limits, free tier and egress rules are quoted from the vendor's own pricing, limits, security and sign-in pages.
